stem: My brother ___ to Beijing last summer.
analysis: last summer 是过去时间状语，提示使用一般过去时。go 的过去式是不规则变化 went。A 是原形，C 是三单，D 是将来时。

stem: Lucy is ___ than her sister.
analysis: than 是比较级的标志词，形容词比较级 + than 表示
。tall 的比较级是 taller。A 是原形，C/D 是最高级。

source: 北京版六年级单元测试
stem: We ___ a sports meeting next week.
analysis: next week 是将来的时间状语，使用一般将来时 will + 动词原形。A 是一般现在时，B 是过去时，D 是现在进行时。

source: 北京各区期末高频考点
stem: This is not ___ bag. ___ is over there.
analysis: 第一空后有名詞 bag，需要用形容词性物主代词 my 修饰。第二空后没有名詞，做主语，用名詞性物主代词 Mine。

stem: There ___ some milk and two apples on the table.
analysis: There be 句型遵循就近原则，离 be 动词最近的名词是 milk（不可数），所以用 is。have/has 表示所属，不能与 There be 混用。

stem: I have ___ useful book about English.
analysis: useful 以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，所以用 a 而非 an。a/an 的选择看音标而不是看字母。

stem: Look! The children ___ football on the playground.
analysis: Look! 是现在进行时的标志词，结构为 am/is/are + 动词-ing。children 是复数，用 are + playing。

stem: We usually get up ___ 6:30 ___ the morning.
analysis: 具体时间点用 at (at 6:30)；泛指在上午/下午/晚上用 in (in the morning)。on 用于具体某一天。

stem: Tom ___ goes to school late. He is a good student.
analysis: 根据后句 He is a good student 推断，Tom 从不迟到，用 never。always（总是）、usually（通常）、sometimes（有时）会与好学生形象矛盾。

stem: My father ___ to work by car every day.
analysis: every day 是一般现在时标志，主语 My father 是第三人称单数，动词需要加 -s/es。go 的三单形式是 goes。

stem:
— Can you play the piano?
— No, I ___.
analysis: Can 引导的一般疑问句，否定回答用 No, I can't。情态动词 can 后接动词原形，否定形式 can't。

stem: Would you like ___ coffee?
analysis: Would you like...? 是表示邀请或建议的句型，希望得到肯定回答时用 some 而不用 any。这是 some/any 规则的重要例外。

stem:
— ___ do you usually go to school?
— By bus.
analysis: 回答 By bus 是交通方式，问交通方式用 How。What 问什么，Where 问哪里，When 问什么时候。

stem: ___ beautiful the garden is!
analysis: 感叹句公式：How + 形容词/副词 (+ 主语 + 谓语)! beautiful 是形容词，所以用 How。What 用于修饰名詞。

stem: She ___ to the zoo yesterday because it rained.
analysis: 过去时的否定结构是 didn't + 动词原形。didn't 后必须用动词原形，不能再用过去式 went。这是小学阶段最高频的语法错误之一。

stem: There are three ___ (child) in the room.
analysis: three 后接可数名词复数。child 的复数是不规则变化 children，不是 childs。

stem: Listen! The girl ___ (sing) in the classroom.
analysis: Listen! 是现在进行时标志，结构 be + doing。主语 the girl 是单数，用 is singing。

stem: This book is ___ (interesting) than that one.
analysis: 多音节形容词 interesting 的比较级在前面加 more，而不是加 -er。

stem: He ___ (buy) a new bike last weekend.
analysis: last weekend 是过去时间。buy 的过去式是不规则变化 bought，不是 buyed。

stem: He does his homework every day. (改为否定句)
answer: He doesn't do his homework every day.
analysis: 一般现在时第三人称单数的否定：doesn't + 动词原形。does 已经体现三单，所以动词 his homework 前的 do 用原形，不再用 does。

stem: Last Sunday, my family and I went to the park. The weather was ___ (1). We ___ (2) a picnic under a big tree.
analysis: (1) 描述天气，语境是正面积极的；(2) have a picnic 是固定搭配，因为是 Last Sunday，用过去式 had。

stem:
— ___ milk do you want?
— A little, please.
analysis: milk 是不可数名词，提问数量用 How much。How many 用于可数名词，How long 问长度/时间，How often 问频率。

stem: I ___ a cup of tea, please.
analysis: would like + 名詞，表示
。would like to + 动词原形表示
。这里 a cup of tea 是名词。

stem:
— ___ do you like pandas?
— Because they are cute.
analysis: 回答用 Because... 说明问的是原因，用 Why 提问。Why 和 Because 是问答搭档。

stem: ___ in the library, please.
analysis: 祈使句的否定形式是 Don't + 动词原形。图书馆场景提示不能说话。B/C/D 都不是正确的祈使句否定结构。

stem: I ___ my homework already. Can I go out now?
analysis: already 是现在完成时的标志词，结构为 have/has + 过去分词。表示过去完成的动作对现在有影响（作业已完成→现在可以出去）。

stem: Could you tell me ___ the nearest hospital is?
analysis: 宾语从句中，问地点用 where。另外注意宾语从句必须用陈述语序，所以是 where the hospital is 而不是 where is the hospital。

stem: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
analysis: if 引导的条件状语从句遵循「主将从现」原则：主句用一般将来时 (will stay)，从句用一般现在时 (rains) 表示将来。

stem: English ___ widely all over the world.
analysis: English 是「被说」，需要用被动语态。一般现在时的被动结构：am/is/are + 过去分词。spoken 是 speak 的过去分词。

stem: My uncle ___ in Beijing since 2010.
analysis: since 2010 表示从过去持续到现在的动作，用现在完成时 has lived。since + 时间点 / for + 时间段 是现在完成时的标志。

stem: Haidian is one of ___ districts in Beijing for education.
analysis: one of + the + 最高级 + 名词复数，表示「最...之一」。good 的最高级是 the best。

stem:
— Must I finish the work today?
— No, you ___. You can do it tomorrow.
analysis: Must I...? 的否定回答用 No, you needn't (不必要) 或 No, you don't have to。mustn't 表示「禁止」，不用于回答 Must I...?

stem: He ___ be short, but now he is very tall.
analysis: used to + 动词原形表示「过去常常做某事（现在不这样了）」。be used to + doing 表示「习惯于...」。根据语境 but now 可知是今昔对比。

stem: The boy ___ is playing basketball is my brother.
analysis: 先行词 the boy 指人，在定语从句中作主语，关系代词用 who/that。which 指物，what 不用于定语从句，when 指时间。

stem: The box is ___ heavy ___ I can't carry it.
analysis: so + 形容词 + that 从句 表示「如此...以至于...」。too...to 结构后接动词原形（too heavy to carry）。such...that 后接名词。

stem: What ___ you ___ (do) at 8:00 yesterday evening?
analysis: at 8:00 yesterday evening 是过去进行时的标志（过去某个具体时间正在发生的动作）。was/were + doing。

stem: He decided ___ (study) abroad next year.
analysis: decide to do sth 是固定搭配，decide 后接动词不定式 to do。类似搭配还有 want/hope/plan/need to do。

stem: Would you mind ___ (open) the window?
analysis: mind doing sth 是固定搭配，mind 后接动名词。类似搭配还有 enjoy/finish/practice/suggest + doing。

stem: He runs very ___ (quick). He is the fastest in our class.
analysis: 修饰动词 runs 需要用副词 quickly。形容词 quick + ly → 副词 quickly。

stem: She ___ already ___ (visit) the Great Wall twice.
analysis: already + twice 提示现在完成时，have/has + 过去分词。主语 She 是第三人称单数，用 has visited。

stem:
Where does he live? (合并为宾语从句)
Do you know ___?
analysis: 宾语从句必须用陈述语序：连接词 + 主语 + 谓语。原句 Where does he live 变为 where he lives，去掉助动词 does，lives 恢复三单。

stem: Everyone in our class like playing basketball.
analysis: everyone 作主语时谓语用单数形式。虽然中文意思是「每个人」，但 everyone 是不定代词，视为第三人称单数。

stem: Although he is young, but he knows a lot.
analysis: Although 和 but 不能同时使用（中文的
在英语中只能用其一）。改为 Although he is young, he knows a lot.

stem: When I was in Grade 7, I was not good at English. I felt very sad. My teacher Ms. Li ___ (1) me a lot. She told me not to give up and ___ (2) me after class every day.
analysis: (1) 根据前文 was/told 确定全文为过去时，help→helped；(2) 并列谓语，与 told 并列，也用过去式 taught。

grammar: have been to vs have gone to
stem:
— Where is Tom?
— He ___ the library. He'll be back soon.
analysis: have gone to 表示「去了某地（人不在说话处）」。have been to 表示「去过某地（人已回来）」。根据语境 He'll be back soon 可知他还在图书馆没回来。

stem: ___ you work, ___ results you will get.
analysis: 「the + 比较级, the + 比较级」结构表示「越...越...」。The harder you work, the better results you will get. 你越努力，结果越好。

stem:
— Do you like tea or coffee?
— ___. Just water, please.
analysis: 根据 Just water, please 可知两者都不选。either 表示「两者中任一」，neither 表示「两者都不」，both 表示「两者都」，none 表示「三者及以上都不」。

stem: She bought a ___ dress yesterday.
analysis: 英语形容词顺序：观点(beautiful)→颜色(red)→产地(Chinese)。口诀：美小圆旧黄，法国木书房。

stem: ___ important information you've given us!
analysis: information 是不可数名词，感叹句结构：What + 形容词 + 不可数名词 (+ 主语 + 谓语)! 不可数名词前不用 a/an。

stem: My mother asked me ___ too much time on video games.
analysis: ask sb not to do sth 是固定搭配。ask 后接带 to 的不定式，否定形式在 to 前加 not。
